summary: Tested new read-only RouterOS views (logs, ppp-profiles, ppp-secrets, system-clock) end-to-end. Backend: 22 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_readonly_resources.py all pass (health, overview, resource allow-list, reveal param, action allow-list/write protection, backup history/now/schedule). Frontend: dashboard loads, router drawer opens for r-01, all six tabs present with correct data-testids, each new tab fires the API, shows the loading spinner then the demo-router config message; console button label is 'Open native API console' (no WebFig). No 500s, no credential leakage observed.

issues: Six tabs are cramped in the 280px drawer; 'PPP Profiles', 'PPP Secrets', 'System Time' wrap onto two lines and labels are ~10px, hurting legibility/tap targets. Consider horizontal scroll strip or shorter labels (Profiles/Secrets/Clock).

action_items: Blocker for further verification: CREDENTIALS_FERNET_KEY is not set in backend/.env, so POST /api/routers returns 503 and no managed router can be created. Consequence: PPP-secret redaction (•••••• placeholder), reveal=true unredacted path, res-table success rendering, and the ppp-secrets-reveal-toggle button were NOT exercised in a success state anywhere (backend or UI).
Optional: tighten drawer tab layout (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: read_resource redacts only 'password' and 'caller-id' for ppp-secrets; RouterOS /ppp/secret rows can also expose 'last-caller-id' and comments containing credentials - consider extending PPP_SECRET_SENSITIVE.

reveal=true is accepted with no auth/role check; once real routers are onboarded, gate plaintext password reveal behind Super Admin auth and write an audit_log entry (audit_log is only written for write actions today).

ros_call raises RuntimeError on ImportError inside a to_thread call that is caught by a broad `except Exception` and surfaced as 502; acceptable, but the 502 message truncation (180 chars) may still echo router hostnames/usernames from the driver exception to the browser - sanitize.
ResourceTable is keyed by position, not tab; state resets are handled via the effect, but adding key={drawerTab} would avoid stale-render risk if columns/mappings grow.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Attempted POST /api/routers (TEST_Unreachable) returned 503 due to missing CREDENTIALS_FERNET_KEY, so no data was written.
test_credentials: No auth in app; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for these flows
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo routers r-01..r-04 intentionally 404 on resource/action/backup endpoints (expected safety gate) - do not flag. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_readonly_resources.py (plus older test_management_api.py / test_monitoring_api.py which skip). Untested success paths: ppp-secrets redaction/reveal, resource tables with rows, system-time-panel population - all blocked until CREDENTIALS_FERNET_KEY + a real/managed router exist.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. The only gap is environmental: missing CREDENTIALS_FERNET_KEY prevents onboarding a managed router, so the success/redaction branches of the new endpoints and the reveal toggle cannot be verified.
